patella-volume.definition: deck #1: the patella label alone (the proximal patellar ossification is a separate label and is not included)

lateral-meniscus-osteophyte-volume.definition: deck #2: the lab's working reading of meniscus plus spurs on the lateral side (not anatomically checked)

medial-meniscus-osteophyte-volume.definition: deck #3: the lab's working reading of meniscus plus spurs on the medial side (not anatomically checked)

distal-femoral-length-dfl.definition: deck #26: straight distance from a (midpoint of the upper line of the intercondylar groove) to b (intercondylar notch)

distal-femoral-width-dfw.definition: deck #27: straight distance from c (midpoint of the ridge on the lateral condyle) to d (vertex of the medial condyle)

width-length-ratio.definition: deck #28: distal femoral width-to-length ratio, DFW / DFL
